_doc: Hand-checked building facts that win over OSM tags. Only values with a public source. Match by OSM id ("osm": "w123"/"r123") or by name when no id is given. floors = storeys above ground; h = metres to roof. colour/material/roof/roofColour use OSM building:colour / building:material / roof:shape / roof:colour values. facade = window style in js/map.js (campus, glass, concrete, wash, arcade). feature = named extras drawn by js/map.js. split = cut the footprint into blocks: cuts[i] = [[x,z],[x,z]] (block 0 lies left of cut 0 seen from its first point), floors per block. Colours and materials judged from the photos listed (viewed only; nothing from them is used as a texture, all textures are generated in js/map.js). Sources written as 'Google 街景目視判斷（影像 YYYY-MM，觀看點 lat,lon，朝向）' were looked at in Google Street View only: no image was saved or used, only medium/high-confidence sightings are applied (2026-11).

buildings.name: 知行領航館
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2019-05，使用者 360 照片，觀看點 24.958383,121.246160，朝東北 0~60 度）
buildings.note: 3F+B1, 5,471 m2 floor area, opened 2019, address 新中北路499號 (all per the source page). Street view (medium): about 3 storeys (top not fully in frame), box volume with white / royal-blue / light-blue panel boxes and glass bands, flat roof, a large paved forecourt; Google's place marker is at 24.9583988,121.2462024 (game x 373, z -44) with the building to its north-east. Not matched yet: OSM has no footprint named 知行領航館. Checked 2026-11: no unnamed OSM footprint within 90 m of 新中北路 east of the 465號 7-Eleven is large enough (5,471 m2 over 4 storeys needs ~1,300 m2; the largest is 735 m2), and the only footprint within 70 m of the marker is 薄膜中心 (307 m2), so build_map prints 'override not matched' until an OSM id is added as "osm".

buildings.name: 全人教育村
buildings.note: Official: 北棟 6F, 中棟 5F, 南棟 9F, B1 parking. The OSM way is one footprint (OSM tags 7F / 24.5 m); it is cut along its notch at z=-100 and along the diagonal of the joint (-19.3,-81.1)-(-11.5,-80.3) (a straight cut at z=-81 left a 0.8 m wide 9F strip beside the east wing) into the north bar, the east connecting wing and the south block, which are taken as 北/中/南棟 by position (assumption: the source names the blocks but has no plan). Colour: light greyish beige walls in the Commons photo. Street view 2017-09 / 2021-02 was checked but only with low confidence (see unverified), so nothing here was changed.

buildings.name: 懷恩樓
buildings.note: M+ catalogue text: beige building, flat roof, a horizontal block with arches on both levels. Commons photos: continuous round arches on both storeys, light tan face-brick tiles. Floors stay at OSM building:levels=2. (Street view 2017-09 from the fountain shows a beige arcaded building north of it, consistent.)

buildings.name: 張靜愚紀念圖書館
buildings.note: Official: exterior tiles restored in 2014 to the original design; three dome skylights over 修德廳 (1F) and a sunken garden. Photos and street view (medium): grey-brown brick-format tiles, deep-set horizontal window bands, about 5 storeys, flat roof; colour darkened from #9a8d81 to the street-view #7a6a5c. Not modelled: the upper floors stepping out over the lower ones (inverted steps), the skylights and the sunken garden (no source gives their position; the skylights are not visible from the ground and the aerial view is blocked by 科學館). Floors stay at OSM 5F.

buildings.name: 科學館
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2021-02，使用者 360 空拍環景，觀看點 24.956844,121.242195，朝西北 310~345 度）
buildings.note: Photo and street view (high): red-brick tile facade with white window frames and horizontal window bands, flat roof, about 7 storeys plus a raised stair/core tower carrying the white observatory dome (counts as ~8F, matching OSM 8F). The dome now stands on a raised core in the west-middle part of the roof (js/map.js 'observatory'), not at the roof centre; its exact spot is approximate. A thin antenna mast is drawn beside it.

buildings.name: 工學館
buildings.note: Photo (titled 工學院): light beige tiles with a glazed stair core.

buildings.name: 電學大樓
buildings.note: Photo of the College of EECS building (the college is housed in 電學大樓): dark brown tiles, green-tinted windows.

buildings.name: 維澈樓
buildings.note: Photo: glass curtain wall with teal glass and grey spandrel bands.

buildings.name: 學生活動中心
source: https://oosa.cycu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/中原大學活動中心管理細則-1100414.doc.pdf
buildings.note: Photos: white square tiles, colonnade along the ground floor. Colour/material only: the footprint, the McDonald's interior on its east side and the B1 open-air amphitheatre (management rules PDF) are left as they are. Street view 2017-09 could not see it (trees), see unverified.

buildings.name: 恩惠堂
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2017-01，使用者 360 照片，觀看點 24.957367,121.243017，朝北北東 5~25 度；拍攝位置由上傳者標定）
buildings.note: Photos and street view (medium): white walls, pitched roof (grey eaves per the photos; roof colour not readable in the backlit street view), a slender white spire with a cross at the front (south, entrance) end, a single white arched entrance frame and a dark stone sign 基督教浸信會 恩惠堂. The spire is drawn on the ridge near the south gable end (js/map.js 'spire'); its sizes are estimates. Floors stay at the estimate (no source).

buildings.name: 中原大學體育館
buildings.note: M+ catalogue text: flat roof with a pitched section, glass exterior on one side. Street view (medium): about 3 storeys, 12-15 m (h 13.5 m, the middle of that range, instead of OSM height=10m); grey-beige walls with terracotta bands above and below two horizontal window bands on the north and east sides (no glass there); main roof flat with a parapet from the ground, and the pitched red-tile roof belongs to the covered walkway at the south-west entrance, so the old 'pitched_section' over the middle of the roof was replaced by 'entrance_canopy' (drawn along the west part of the most south-west facing wall; its exact extent is an estimate); a round stair tower ('stair_drum', size estimated; position uncertain: the observation says 'south-east side', but both viewpoints (24.960248,121.242085 and 24.960620,121.242579) are north / north-west of the hall and cannot see its geometric south-east corner, so 'south-east' may be relative to the view; it is drawn at the geometric south-east corner as a literal reading until confirmed). The terracotta bands are not modelled. The glass side (south or west, not seen) is not modelled.

buildings.name: 望樓
buildings.note: OSM says levels=3 but height=21 (7 m per floor). The photo shows three storeys, so levels win (10.5 m). White tiles.

buildings.name: 土木館
buildings.note: Photo: grey granite-chip render (洗石子 look). Floors stay at OSM levels=5; OSM height=28 (5.6 m per floor) is not used, the photo does not show the whole height.

buildings.name: 良善樓
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2021-02，使用者 360 空拍環景，觀看點 24.956844,121.242195，朝 178 度）
buildings.note: Street view (medium): about 9 rows of windows (matches OSM 9F, kept), flat roof with a white cylindrical crown ('roof_drum', drawn near the roof middle: its spot is approximate). The south face on 大仁街 is light grey-white tiles with a blue glass curtain strip and stacked balconies; the north face seen from the aerial view looks dark grey-brown. The game has one wall tint per building, so the south (street) face colour is used; the glass strip and the north colour are not modelled.

buildings.name: 信實樓
buildings.note: Street view (medium): taupe tiles with light horizontal balcony bands (blue band on the left wing), flat roof with a framed parapet, multi-wing dorm around a planted courtyard, canopy entrance. About 10-11 storeys including the ground floor, so OSM 10F is kept. Image is from 2017; later changes cannot be checked. The balcony bands and roof frame are not modelled.

buildings.name: 設計學院
buildings.note: Street view (medium): a single-storey building (OSM levels=1 is right, kept) with off-white walls, deep eaves and a row of continuous dark-grey gabled roofs (Japanese-style bungalow look), garden with stone seats in front. Drawn as a row of small gables along the long side ('gable_row'); the number of gables (~one per 7 m) is an estimate.

buildings.name: 室設系館
buildings.note: Street view (medium): 4 rows of windows, light grey-white tiles with horizontal window rows, flat roof, canopy over the ground-floor entrance. OSM levels=3 / height=21 replaced by 4F (h = 4 x 3.3 + 0.6 = 13.8 m, within the 13-14 m seen).

鐘塔.note: Photos: two slender fair-faced concrete pylons joined at the top, a bell hung between them and a cross on top; no clock faces, no brick. Height has no written source: the total (19 m pylons + 5 m cross) is kept close to the old model (24.8 m). OSM node 4845066050 man_made=tower, alt_name=二一鐘. Street view 2021-02 aerial suggests 15-20 m but with low confidence, so the height was not changed (see unverified).

舊校門.note: Photo Cycu_gate.jpg (described 中原大學校門): three white concrete round arches side by side, with the characters 中原大學 on plaques. The current main gate (CYCU_Gate_New.jpg) is a twisted metal sculpture. Street view (high) at this POI's position confirms the structure: a free-standing frame of three equal semicircular white concrete arches (slightly weathered) on slim columns, no deck, no roof, the middle arch over the stone-paved driveway. Scaled from cars: columns ~4-5 m, ~7-8 m overall, so colH 4.5 m (was 5.2) and slimmer 0.55 m columns (was 0.7) give 4.5 + 2.8 + 0.6 = 7.9 m. The name 舊校門 comes from the OSM POI. The width (~21 m, 5.6 m arch span) is still an estimate.

中原噴水池.note: Street view (high): a low round raised basin of light grey stone, ~12-15 m across (d 13 m; the OSM water polygon is only ~8.7 m), rim ~0.4-0.5 m high, in a round grey stone-paved plaza with concentric curved stone benches / planters, palms beside it and the beige arcade building (懷恩樓) to the north. The basin was dry or low when photographed; the game keeps shallow water and the small spray. The plaza rings and four bench arcs are drawn in js/map.js; their radii are estimates.

Google 街景 2017-09 (24.959849,121.240672 朝西 255~270 度) and 2026-05 (新中北路 363 號 朝 300 度): a 5-6 storey building with dark-green / white striped end walls, probably 喜樂樓, but low confidence (partly hidden by a canopy), so floors and colour unchanged
